title: Finish Rust Store Hook Migration
description: Finish the architectural migration across semio/rs, semio/js, semio/react, and semio/sketchpad so that: 1) semio/sketchpad no longer uses general kit hooks and kit hooks come exclusively from semio/rs-backed surfaces, 2) semio/js contains no kit domain logic and only runtime/transport/schema glue that remains appropriate there, 3) existing sketchpad/playwright functionality is preserved, and 4) the Playwright suite passes. Investigate current ownership, refactor the minimal boundary needed, update existing tests instead of creating new ones, and verify with targeted and full Playwright runs.
summary: Routed sketchpad kit details metadata editing through semio/react hook setters instead of calling the sketchpad kit app store change method, extended semio/react kit metadata field hooks to target the kit client, extended semio/rs set/get field RPC for kit description/icon/image/version/homepage/license, adjusted js kit client runtime fallback initialization for Node/jsdom, and extended existing semio/react embedded tests to cover kit metadata hook writes. Fixed semio/assets TypeScript schema drift for design parent access so semio/react build passes. Verification: semio/react build passed, semio/react embedded tests passed, semio/sketchpad Vite build passed, semio/rs cargo check passed, targeted Rust kit metadata tests passed. Full semio/js tests remain red on unrelated pre-existing geometry/hash/paste failures and ENOSPC disk exhaustion during tmp/cache writes.
